# 3ngram v1.8.7

Patch: the database and HTTP runtime pins move to their newest releases past
the 7-day cooldown, and every request body that body-parser rejects now gets
its client error instead of a 500.

## Changes

- **Rejected request bodies are client errors** (#312, resolves #301).
  `express.json()` runs before any route, and only a malformed JSON body was
  mapped to 400 `invalid_request`; an oversized body or an unsupported
  content encoding fell through to 500 `internal_error` and an unhandled-error
  log line. A body over the 100 KB default limit now returns 413
  `payload_too_large`, an unsupported `Content-Encoding` or charset returns
  415 `unsupported_media_type`, and a corrupt or truncated compressed body
  returns 400 `invalid_request`. Each is logged at warn with the status and
  body-parser type only, never the body. `/mcp`, `/api/v1` and the
  form-encoded OAuth endpoints share the handler.

- **drizzle-orm 0.45.4, pg 8.23.1, hono 4.13.13** (#303). `drizzle-orm`
  0.45.3 adds a Netlify DB driver entry point and 0.45.4 fixes explicit
  `.prepare(name)` on the `postgres-js` driver; the `node-postgres` driver
  this engine uses is unchanged. `pg` 8.22/8.23 add opt-in direct SSL
  negotiation and query pipelining (both off unless configured), rewrite the
  Bind serializer, warn on an invalid `Date` parameter, and surface a socket
  reset on a pooled client as `ECONNRESET` instead of a later "Connection
  terminated unexpectedly". `withTenant()`'s `set_config(..., true)` path,
  `pg-pool` 3.14.0 and the `ssl` default are unchanged. `hono` 4.13.12/13
  are fixes in modules the engine does not import; the pin governs the copy
  `@modelcontextprotocol/node` pulls in.

- **express 5.3.0** (#311). `res.send()` no longer adds `Content-Length`
  when `Transfer-Encoding` is already set, `req.fresh` revalidates QUERY
  requests, HTML redirect bodies gain a doctype and title, and
  `content-type` moves to 2.0 (faster parser; `res.send()` keeps existing
  `Content-Type` parameters when it appends the charset and no longer throws
  on an unparsable `Content-Type`) with `type-is` 2.1 and
  `content-disposition` 2.0.1. No route or error-handling behaviour changes.

- **CI**: the unused Turbo remote cache wiring is gone and the cache is
  disabled explicitly (#308). No published output changes.

## Compatibility

- **Runtime pin lockstep.** Consumers that pin `drizzle-orm`, `pg`, `hono` or
  `express` exactly next to `@3ngram/db` or `@3ngram/server` must move to
  0.45.4, 8.23.1, 4.13.13 and 5.3.0 together. `@3ngram/db` pins drizzle-orm
  and pg exactly, and a second drizzle-orm copy fails to typecheck against
  the engine's table types; `@3ngram/server` pins express exactly, and a
  consumer that mounts its own routers into the engine app must share that
  one copy.
- **New error codes.** Clients that switch on the JSON `error` field may see
  `payload_too_large` (413) and `unsupported_media_type` (415) where they
  previously received `internal_error` (500).

## Operations

No migration and no configuration change.
